# Sober Bar & Kitchen

> Alcohol-free cocktails, coffee, breakfast, and lunch in downtown Gulfport, Florida. Walk-ins welcome. Open daily at 7am.

Sober Bar & Kitchen (also called Sober Bar) serves craft zero-proof cocktails, specialty coffee, and New Orleans-inspired food. No spirits, wine or beer with alcohol. NA beers are labeled 0.0% or <0.5% ABV.

## Dayparts

- From 7am: coffee, breakfast, and the full menu. Walk-ins are welcome.
- Daytime: coffee-house energy with Wi-Fi.
- Evening: zero-proof cocktails until close (10pm Sun–Thu, midnight Fri–Sat).

## Useful answers

- No spirits, wine or beer with alcohol. NA beers are labeled 0.0% or <0.5% ABV.
- The venue has approximately 50 seats: about 30 indoors and 20 on the patio. Walk-ins are welcome; reservations are available.
- It is in Gulfport, close to St. Petersburg and St. Pete Beach.
